deviations.reason: Task agents ran git stash/stash pop to check a load-dependent test failure; git's stash is shared across all worktrees, so concurrent stashes swapped untracked files between agents. deltas.behavior_text: The dataset build carves each source's train split into five sides (train / fit / selection / sealed held-out / test) instead of fit / selection / held-out; only the train side can become training targets, and teacher labelling refuses fit/selection/held-out ids even though their source split is 'train'.

The quantize stage can build torchao weight-only int8 and int4 students (merged torso, fp32 pointer head) served by jev-factory's /v1/systemone wrapper on 127.0.0.1, under the memory-capped GPU runner; a failed build is recorded unavailable with its error.

A per-question-kind answer-or-abstain decision gate (floor, margin, max_entropy) is fitted on the fit fold of the deployed student, shipped as gate.json in the bundle, and reported (coverage, selective accuracy) in the final report.
jev distill takes the stage as a positional argument: the jev-CLI domain has one jev.distill operation with a grounded stage argument instead of one operation per stage.

The SystemOne parser accepts score probabilities keyed by level index ('0'..'n-1', as the real strands-decider server and typed-decisions gold emit) in addition to criteria-keyed and list forms, still failing closed on missing/extra/out-of-range/bad-sum answers.
